description: March 6 Beirut and Tripoli teacher sit-ins and the March 13 Beirut secondary-teacher sit-in are confirmed, but the opened contemporaneous reports give no site-specific headcount. L’Orient snippets that say “dozens” are held/search-only and were not used.
required_followup: Find a permitted non-held body or primary record with simultaneous headcount for each actual site; otherwise retain pending_threshold.

description: March 21 roadblocks are reported at separate sites in Beirut, Tripoli, Akkar, Bekaa, north Lebanon and Tyre. There is no per-site count. Arab News says “hundreds” across Beirut, Tripoli and Bekaa collectively; this cannot be assigned to any single site. Several reports frame the grievance as economic conditions/currency without a clear state-policy addressee at each site.
required_followup: Seek site-specific contemporary reporting or records, especially attendance and direct demands; preserve local candidates separately and do not allocate aggregate estimates.

description: March 22 Beirut retired military/depositor crowd is reported as “hundreds” by The National, enough for a provisional threshold, but exact number and method are absent. LBCI corroborates occurrence and response but does not independently count.
required_followup: Independent permitted numeric or qualitative count and fuller organizer/episode context.

description: The Saida public-administration employees’ sit-in is documented by three reports, but no count establishes 50 at that courtyard. Daily Beirut labels the article Thursday March 23, while Janobiyat and IMLebanon date the action March 22; maintain March 22 provisionally with the publication/event-date mismatch visible.
required_followup: Resolve exact event date if possible and obtain a simultaneous crowd estimate at Saida; do not aggregate attendees or actions in other governorates.

description: None of the March bodies gives a clear physical end date/time for the teacher gatherings, March 21 blockades or March 22 demonstrations. The ongoing teachers’ strike/public-administration strike is contextual, not evidence that a street assembly remained continuous.
required_followup: Retrospective or follow-up reporting explicitly establishing closure or sustained public assembly; do not set same-day end by default.

description: L’Orient/L’Orient Today results on March 6 and March 13 teacher protests, March 22 Beirut protests and Tripoli road actions remain search-only under the held source-family restriction. No bodies or variants were requested; all snippets remain discovery only.
required_followup: No follow-up to held sources; use separately permitted sources only.

description: Saida City Net’s search result carries near-identical headline and long text to Daily Beirut S005, while IMLebanon S011 explicitly attributes its shorter story to NNA. No explicit origin/republishing relationship was resolved for Saida City Net or between Daily Beirut and Janobiyat. Do not count these as independent attendance confirmation; none supplies a number.
required_followup: Check explicit article/source attribution in any permitted further record; do not infer independence from different domains.

description: Search outputs surfaced a private-school teachers’ strike on March 14 and an undated/unclear-year prospective teachers’ sit-in plan. A strike or announcement alone does not verify a qualifying public gathering. The March 9 Saida women’s vigil was body-opened and is separately coded as E014 pending threshold.
required_followup: For dated leads, seek allowed post-event sources that establish occurrence, date, site, state demand and simultaneous attendance; otherwise retain discovery-only.

description: Eleven captured searches cover English and Arabic, with queries about general March mobilization, teachers, public employees, retirees, roadblocks and regional sites. Coverage is partial, not exhaustive: no Lexis-Nexis equivalent, no systematic official/union archive review, limited French-language searching, and many sectors/dates/governorates remain under-covered. Native search clocks are unavailable; captures preserve exact query/returned headers and rendered outputs.
required_followup: Further date-window, sector and governorate searches across permitted local/international sources; baseline and archive gates remain open.

description: March teacher sit-ins are possibly related to the January public-teacher mobilization/strike, but the evidence establishes new dated assemblies, not a continuous physical gathering. March public-employee sit-in may relate to the ongoing sector strike, but direct link to any earlier candidate is not demonstrated.
required_followup: Compare neighboring-month evidence during review; do not duplicate continuing physical events or merge separate action days without direct linkage.

description: SaidaOnline body confirms a March 9 solidarity vigil at Ilya Square with own-state political/economic criticism, but reports only “a number of mothers and women” and no count; >=50 simultaneous attendance is unproven.
required_followup: Find a permitted contemporaneous source with a site-specific attendance estimate; otherwise retain pending_threshold.
